Ellen (SRE): Postmortem follow-up: several private customers saw intermittent control-plane failures correlated with VPC peering flaps. Likely combo: MTU fragmentation + asymmetric return path. Need owners, quick ETA, and an oncall checklist.

Tarun (Eng-Infra): I will own the validation probe and runbook snippet. Plan: lightweight probe that checks PMTU and verifies reassembly. ETA: 72h.

Priya (Private Deploy): I'll own the agent-side mitigation (MSS clamp toggle + handshake retry). Will prepare opt-in config and a small staging canary. ETA: next sprint, can fast-track with pcaps.

Marta (CSE): I'll gather affected customer list and upload pcaps/device configs to ticket INC-5099. Customers agreed to run tcpdump during next window.

sync-bot: INC-5099 created and assigned to: Ellen, Tarun, Priya. Priority: P2.

Ellen (SRE): Runbook should include:
- triage commands (ping -M do, traceroute, tcpdump fragment check)
- criteria to flip to dedicated fallback + approver contact
- links to probe and ticket INC-5099

Tarun (Eng-Infra): Example quick checks to include:
```bash
# PMTU probe
ping -M do -s 1400 -c 3 10.10.10.1
# detect fragments
sudo tcpdump -n -s 0 'ip[6:2] & 0x3fff != 0' -c 20
```
I'll post a PR to infra-monitoring for the probe (ETA 72h).

Priya (Private Deploy): Note: some customer firewalls drop fragments silently. Agent opt-in flag `agent.mss_clamp=true` will be available for ops to toggle. Canary plan: 1% traffic mirrored in staging.

Marta (CSE): Uploaded first pcap to INC-5099 showing fragmentation-needed ICMPs. Will collect more.

Ellen (SRE): Action summary:
- Tarun: probe + runbook snippet (ETA 72h)
- Priya: agent opt-in patch + canary (ETA sprint end / expedite if pcaps confirm)
- Marta: pcaps + device configs (ETA tomorrow)

Please ack with :thumbsup: when you accept ownership. We'll keep this thread as canonical remediation tracker and convert to a weekly 15m sync if INC-5099 remains open after a week.

Tarun (Eng-Infra): :thumbsup:

Priya (Private Deploy): :thumbsup:
